headline: North Park leads the CCIW in scoring
dek: North Park scored 49 goals across all matches while conceding twenty, posting fifteen wins alongside five draws and two defeats. That attack carried the program through an unbeaten conference slate before Tufts ended its season.

pattern.label: signal
pattern.text: High goal totals have not guaranteed wins in the CCIW: Millikin scored 47 goals across the season, yet conceded 47 and finished with eight wins, one draw, and nine losses.

wire.line: Illinois Wesleyan has conceded only nine goals all season while scoring 32.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Three scheduled August matches have passed without a published result: Carroll against Milwaukee School of Engineering, Augustana (Ill.) at Illinois Tech, and Augustana (Ill.) against Eureka.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Augustana (Ill.) goalkeeper Elias Banke has made 88 saves while allowing twenty goals for a 0.815 save percentage.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: North Park freshman forward Gustav Finér has scored eleven goals on 70 shots while adding five assists.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Millikin has spread its attack across at least fourteen different goal scorers this season.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Carroll has conceded 54 goals across its matches, more than any other CCIW program.

last_match.line: The loss ended an unbeaten run stretching back to North Park's season opener at Chicago.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
